title: Helsinki’s colour palette

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Specify color by production medium because a familiar hue can shift when ink, paint and screens reproduce it differently.
strategic_value: Pairing named colors with familiar buildings, transport and materials can connect Helsinki’s palette to lived experience while production notes preserve reproduction limits.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section opens with production-system guidance and a city-photo/palette collage, then pairs twelve named color fields with urban photographs and their codes, ending with white and black definitions.
practical_value: Choose the value for the actual medium and check the explicit RAL mismatches instead of assuming every code is equivalent.

content_islands.name: Production guidance
content_islands.spec: Explain print, screen, paint and decal systems and their approximation limits.

content_islands.name: Palette and city collage
content_islands.spec: Pair urban details and color strips, then state metallic-use and digital-service qualifications.

content_islands.name: Named colors
content_islands.spec: Stack twelve color entries with their codes and adjacent photographs: brickwork, tram, copper roof, metro, fog, bus, arms, summer, Engel, Suomenlinna, silver and gold.

content_islands.name: Neutrals
content_islands.spec: Finish with White and Black definitions and a black/white specimen.

ingredient.name: Production color definitions
ingredient.role: Keep named city colors recognizable across media.
ingredient.application: Select the supplied medium-specific code or ASE palette; retain coated/uncoated and metallic distinctions.
ingredient.scope: Do not treat RAL approximations for Copper, Fog, Engel and Suomenlinna as exact matches. Digital services refer to separate HDS definitions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says ready-made palettes reduce incorrect color-code use.
reference_purposes.Expression: City photographs are paired with twelve named color fields, followed by white and black definitions.
reference_purposes.Application: Each swatch supplies production-specific color values.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Copper, Fog, Engel and Suomenlinna RAL Classic values do not reproduce their true hues; digital-service colors have separate HDS guidance.
